title: I’ve been many versions of myself… but this one? I like her. ❤️
hook: I’ve been many versions of myself… but this one? I like her. ❤️
caption:
I’ve been many versions of myself… but this one? I like her. ❤️

She’s not perfect. She’s still learning, still healing, still growing—but she’s different.

She protects her peace. She trusts herself more. She’s learned from the woman she used to be without being ashamed of her.

Every version of me was necessary to get me here. But this version? She made a decision to stop starting over and begin again for the last time. ✨

The more I become her, the more I realize… this is the woman I was always becoming. 🦋

I like her. I’m proud of her, and I’m just getting started. ❤️

~ Coach Wa

title: Your muscles don’t know the number on the dumbbell. They don’t know your pace, your reps, or what your workout used to look like.
hook: Your muscles don’t know the number on the dumbbell. They don’t know your pace, your reps, or what your workout used to look like.
caption:
Your muscles don’t know the number on the dumbbell. They don’t know your pace, your reps, or what your workout used to look like.

They respond to stress + consistency + recovery. 💪

So meet yourself where you are today.

😴 Tired? Scale it back.
🩹 Dealing with an injury? Modify it.
🆕 Just starting? Start lighter.
🔥 Feeling strong? Challenge yourself.

Your workout doesn’t have to look the same every day to count.

Progress isn’t about doing more every time. It’s about doing what your body needs so you can keep showing up.

Save this for the days you need the reminder. ❤️
